title: Unpaid Remainder of a Shipped Specialty Pharmacy Program Fill
content:
**Rule.** For a shipped Specialty Pharmacy Program fill, the fill's unpaid remainder is set as follows:

- When the fill's ledger shows card or member payments on it, the fill's unpaid remainder is its total cost share less those payments.
- When the fill shows no payments and was dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy or a retail pharmacy, its unpaid remainder is zero, because that cost share is settled at the dispensing pharmacy.
- Otherwise the fill's unpaid remainder is the balance due shown on the enrollment.

## What is counted as a payment on the fill

- **Card payments** are the copay card assistance applications on the enrollment's ledger that name the fill. Each copay card payment counts once, although the history also shows it as a matching manufacturer-program payment.
- **Member payments** are the payments the member has made that name the fill.

## Decision table

| Card or member payments on the fill | Dispensing pharmacy | Unpaid remainder |
|---|---|---|
| Some | any | total cost share less the card and member payments on the fill |
| None | outside specialty pharmacy or retail pharmacy | zero |
| None | Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | the balance due shown on the enrollment |

## Worked cases (assumed figures)

| Fill | Total cost share | Card payments on it | Member payments on it | Balance due shown | Unpaid remainder |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy fill | $180.00 | $120.00 | $0.00 | $410.00 | $60.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy fill | $180.00 | $120.00 | $20.00 | $410.00 | $40.00 |
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy fill | $180.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $410.00 | $410.00 |
| Retail pharmacy fill | $180.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $410.00 | $0.00 |
